title: Quiet Current
concept: Energy as something you never have to think about. Cool, pale surfaces, one saturated cobalt, a geometric sans and a great deal of empty space; the product is shown large and alone.
rationale: Positions the Cell as a calm household appliance. Strong for product photography and for trust, weaker at explaining what the battery actually does through a day.
emotionalIntent: Relief: nothing here needs your attention.

typography.character: One geometric sans in two weights

motion.personality: Slow fades and a gentle drift

imagery.style: Large product renders on seamless pale grounds

signature: A soft ring that pulses once when power changes direction.
usabilityImplications: Very low visual noise helps scanning.
Pale-on-pale surfaces need careful borders for low-vision users.
technicalRequirements: High-quality product renders for every viewport
risks: Close to gadget minimalism, which the brief asks to avoid.
Depends on product renders the client does not have yet.
